text:
Anna L.: heads up, saw a perf regression on the CUTLASS path when seqlen=32 + kv-hot traffic. tail latency spikes under bursty backpressure. anyone else see this? :eyes:

Jia W.: interesting, was that on H100 or A100? cutlass vs triton?

Anna L.: H100. routing favored CUTLASS for batch shapes we expected to be triton-friendly. probe telemetry shows fallback oscillation around 32-48 tokens.

Marc D.: can you paste the sampler/probe log? my hunch is the probe sampling window is too small and batch-smearing makes kernel arbiter flip.

Anna L.: here are the relevant lines from runtime log:
```
[2026-04-12 16:02:01] probe: seq=32 batch=3 kernel=CUTLASS throughput=410 tps=...
[2026-04-12 16:02:02] fallback: triton_threshold=0.85 measured=0.72 -> choose=CUTLASS
[2026-04-12 16:02:03] kv-affinity: hit_ratio=0.67 cached_kv=hot
[2026-04-12 16:02:04] probe: seq=48 batch=2 kernel=TRITON throughput=380
[2026-04-12 16:02:04] arbiter: route_change detected -> toggle kernel
```

Sasha R.: kv-affinity=hot means large KV cache reuse; CUTLASS sometimes wins for small batches because of kernel startup cost. but the oscillation suggests hysteresis is too weak.

Jia W.: agree. we recently lowered the hysteresis window to reduce latency for cold starts. that could make the router flip under mixed seqlen loads.

Marc D.: quick mitigation: increase hysteresis to 2000ms or require 3 consecutive probes before switching. also bias by kv-affinity: prefer same kernel when kv_hit_ratio>0.6.

Anna L.: can we try a config change in canary? something like:
```json
{"kernel_router": {"hysteresis_ms": 2000, "min_stable_probes": 3, "kv_affinity_threshold": 0.6}}
```

Jia W.: will push as canary to h100-pool-2. perf-bot will post telemetry after 15m.

perf-bot: Canary deploy started on h100-pool-2 for kernel_router changes. Monitoring TTL=15m. :robot_face:

Sasha R.: long term we should include sequence-length histograms in the decision function, not just instant probe. e.g., maintain EWMA of seqlen per route and prefer kernel optimized for the EWMA. this avoids flip when a single long request appears.

Marc D.: good idea. add an alpha param for seqlen_ewma. also track kv-hot decay so affinity doesn't persist after cold period.

Jia W.: pushing canary now. will revert if tail p99 increases. cc @Anna L. for verification.

Anna L.: thanks. if this stabilizes, we should also write a short playbook: how to adjust hysteresis vs latency SLO tradeoffs. saved me some debugging time. :+1:

perf-bot: Canary telemetry: 15m window report -> p50 improved 5%, p95 stable, p99 reduced 12% after hysteresis bump. Link: https://perf.internal/reports/1868009999

Anna L.: looks promising. schedule follow-up in #eng-runtime sync tomorrow to discuss EWMA plan.

Sasha R.: I'll draft an RFC for seqlen-EWMA & kv-decay heuristics.

Marc D.: TL;DR: short-term hysteresis bump + kv-affinity bias. long-term: seqlen-EWMA + smarter probe sampling.

Anna L.: perfect. closing thread once RFC lands.
